items.title: The biggest difference from 2000: nobody is hoarding tokens
items.title_zh: 这次和2000年最大的区别：没有人囤token
items.summary: Former Nvidia engineer Neil Movva argues that, unlike the speculative bets on an unknown future during the 2000 dot-com bubble, today's AI compute (token) consumption has 'instant value' - people buy tokens to use them immediately, not to hoard - meaning inference-driven compute spending rests on real, immediate demand and won't repeat the speculative bust.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达前工程师Neil Movva认为，与2000年互联网泡沫时期押注未知未来的‘投机性’投资不同，当下的AI算力（Token）消费具有‘即时价值’——人们购买Token是为了立即使用而非囤积，这意味着由AI推理驱动的算力支出是建立在真实且即时的需求之上的，不会重演历史上的投机破灭
